description: GaWF shuffle-ablation switch recovery on the joint-balanced test movie with 512-frame rollouts and reset-frame exclusion.
notes: Conditions are baseline, shuffle_digit, shuffle_sector, and shuffle_all.
The dataset suffix is 40h-float32-jointswitch-balanced-10digit-unique; K=10, pre_K=10, sequence_length=512, and every rollout t=0 frame is excluded.
The completed runner used GPU0 only after verifying that the exact formal_gpu0.lock owner had exited and GPU memory use was below 2 GB.
All ten ablation_metrics.json leaves were fetched and checksum-verified before local rendering.
The final PDF is results/save/Supple1_jointswitch_balanced_10digit_unique_sector_covered_prepost10_fig_shuffle_ablation_switch_recovery.pdf; no output was written to results/figs/G_behaviour.
